name: ai.forkmate/forkmate
title: Forkmate
description: Free AI calorie & macro tracker: tell your AI what you ate and it logs it to your private food diary

ai.forkmate.tagline: Track calories by talking to your AI assistant — free
ai.forkmate.long_description:
Forkmate turns any MCP-capable AI — Claude, Cursor, or your own — into an effortless food tracker. Just say what you ate in plain language and your assistant logs it to your private diary, tallying calories and macros MyFitnessPal-style. See it all any time in a clean web diary at app.forkmate.ai.

Ask "how many calories today?" or "what did I eat this week?" and it recalls your day or a date range with per-day totals. Need real numbers? It can search USDA FoodData Central and Open Food Facts for grounded macros, or look up a packaged food by barcode, and every food names the public source its numbers came from. In the web app you confirm each entry before it saves; over MCP your assistant logs what you asked it to, and you can correct or delete any entry afterwards. You can correct or remove an entry, and keep a food profile of what you like, dislike and are allergic to, which your assistant reads before suggesting a meal. It also knows the foods you eat most often, so "the usual" is one sentence.

Why it's different: logging happens in the conversation you're already having — no forms, no database to search, no ads. The food data is open and public, not a black box. It's built for people who train, not just diet, and it stays encouraging rather than obsessive. Your data is yours — every call is scoped to your authenticated account, writes only ever touch your own diary, and export is free.

Forkmate is free. All of it — your complete history, unlimited entries, barcode scanning, chain-restaurant menus. No credit card, no trial timer, no paid plan.

tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.summary: Diagnostic: confirms the connected Forkmate account (read-only).
tools.description: Confirms that your AI is connected to your Forkmate account — a read-only diagnostic that returns no account id, email or other identifier.

tools.name: get_day
tools.title: Get day's diary
tools.summary: Read one day's diary with its calorie and macro totals (read-only).
tools.description: Reads one day's food diary with its calorie and macro totals. Ask "how many calories today?" Read-only.

tools.name: get_range
tools.title: Get diary range
tools.summary: Read a date range with per-day totals for trends and recall (read-only).
tools.description: Reads a date range with per-day calorie and macro totals — for trends and weekly recall. Read-only.

tools.name: get_preferences
tools.title: Get food profile
tools.summary: Read your food profile: likes, dislikes, allergies and diet style (read-only).
tools.description: Reads your food profile — foods you like and dislike, allergies and diet style — so your assistant can respect it when suggesting or logging food. Read-only.

tools.name: update_preferences
tools.title: Update food profile
tools.summary: Add or remove likes, dislikes and allergies, or set your diet style (a write, own-profile only).
tools.description: Saves what you tell your assistant about your tastes: add or remove foods you like or dislike, add or remove allergies, or set your diet style. A write, scoped to your own profile; you can see and edit it in Settings.

tools.name: get_usual_foods
tools.title: Get usual foods
tools.summary: Read the foods you eat most often and the last week's foods (read-only).
tools.description: Reads the foods you log most often and what you ate in the last seven days, so "same as usual" can be logged in one sentence. Read-only.

tools.name: log_meal
tools.title: Log a meal
tools.summary: Log what you ate to your private diary (a write; never destructive).
tools.description: Logs what you ate to your private diary from plain-language text. A write, but never destructive — it only appends a new entry, never edits or deletes.

tools.name: update_meal
tools.title: Update a meal
tools.summary: Correct an entry already in your diary (a write, own-diary only).
tools.description: Corrects an entry already in your diary — a wrong quantity or a mis-parsed food. A write, scoped to your own diary.

tools.name: delete_meal
tools.title: Delete a meal
tools.summary: Remove an entry from your diary (a write, own-diary only).
tools.description: Removes an entry from your diary. A write, scoped to your own diary; nothing else is affected.

tools.name: search_foods
tools.title: Search foods
tools.summary: Search USDA FoodData Central and Open Food Facts for grounded macros (read-only, external).
tools.description: Searches USDA FoodData Central and Open Food Facts for grounded, per-100g macros you can confirm before logging. Read-only; reaches external public databases.

tools.name: lookup_barcode
tools.title: Look up barcode
tools.summary: Look up a packaged food by UPC/EAN barcode (read-only, external).
tools.description: Looks up a packaged food by its UPC/EAN barcode via Open Food Facts. Read-only; reaches an external public database.
